mute.send_muted_hint: The performer has muted their own send. It cannot be unmuted from the host.
status.latency_hint: The upper limit of the jitter buffer for every channel. Shorter means less delay, but the audio drops out more easily when the connection fluctuates.
mixer.no_channels: No participants yet. Copy the invite and send it to the performers.
mixer.link_hint: Jitter: measured variation in packet arrival. Buffer: how much audio is held to absorb it.
mixer.return_hint: Return monitor: sends this performer a mix without their own voice. Every channel of the same performer switches the same return.
approval.title: Join requests
approval.empty: No one is waiting for approval.
confirm.end_session_message: All participants will be disconnected and the invite will stop working. This cannot be undone.
toast.planned: "{feature}" is under development. It will be available in a future update.
toast.gain_not_applied: The level change did not reach the engine, so the display was reverted.
toast.update_after_session: Version {version} can be installed after the session ends.
history.title: Notifications
error.REJECTED: The host did not accept the request
error.INVITE_INVALID: The invite code or URL is not valid
error.UNREACHABLE: Cannot reach the host. Check the network and firewall settings
error.REVISION_CONFLICT: Another change happened at the same time. Please try again
error.INVALID_STATE: This operation is not available now
error.DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Can't open the output device. No other device was selected
notice.output_lost: The output device is gone. Master was muted for safety. Choose a new output.
notice.input_missing: The microphone is missing. Check the connection or choose another input.
notice.return_output_lost: The return monitor output device is missing. Reconnect it or choose another device.
notice.plugin_editor_failed: Could not open the editor of {name}.
client.title: VOCROZ (performer)
client.waiting_approval_hint: Waiting for the host of "{session}" to accept.
client.app_audio_hint: Sends the sound playing on this PC (such as a backing track) on a channel separate from the microphone.
client.send_muted_hint: Your audio is not being sent. Press to start sending.
client.sending_hint: Your audio is being sent to the host. Press to stop.
client.output_missing: The selected output device is not available. Reconnect it or choose another device.
client.return_off: The host is not sending the return.
client.return_on: The host is sending the return.
client.return_hint: Hear the other performers and the backing without your own voice. The host operator turns the return on and off.
notice.update_available: Version {version} is available. It can be installed after the session ends.
routing.title: Routing
routing.state_applied: This is the applied routing. Changes do not affect the sound until you press Apply.
routing.ready: You have unapplied changes. No problems found; ready to apply.
routing.needs_approval: There is a feedback loop through a delay node. Approve the loop to apply.
routing.issue.UNKNOWN_NODE: Refers to a channel or node that does not exist
routing.issue.INVALID_SEND_TAP: Pre-fader sends are only possible from channels and buses
routing.issue.DELAY_OUT_OF_RANGE: Delay out of range (delay nodes 3–2000 ms, manual delays 0–1000 ms)
routing.issue.OVERLAPPING_OUTPUTS: Output channels overlap the main output or another output
routing.issue.UNDELAYED_LOOP: Cannot apply: a loop does not pass through a delay node
routing.issue.UNKNOWN_PLUGIN: Cannot apply: an inserted plugin was not found
routing.main_output_hint: Master plays from the main output (channels 1–2). Extra outputs use other channels of the same device.
routing.delay_hint: Feedback loops are only possible through a delay node, and only after approval.
routing.send_hint: Channels always feed Master. New sends start muted.
routing.input_delay_hint: Add delay per channel to line up arrival times.
routing.levels_empty: No buses or sends are applied.
notice.external_output_failed: Could not start the external output. Check the destination and the key.
notice.external_output_source_removed: The bus used by the external output was removed, so the external output was stopped.
external_output.title: External output (SRTP)
external_output.hint: Sends the selected bus to an external receiver, encrypted with SRTP. It is stopped at startup.
external_output.key_configured: A key is set. Enter a new key only to change it.
external_output.key_missing: No key is set. Nothing can be sent without a key.
external_output.key_copied: Key copied. Paste it into the receiver's settings.
external_output.test_hint: While stopped, sends a 1 kHz test tone for a few seconds over the same encrypted path.
external_output.result.RESOLVE_FAILED: Could not resolve the destination name
external_output.result.SEND_FAILED: Could not send to the destination
external_output.result_note: Check on the receiver whether it could decrypt the stream.
